title: Candidate flow & loop gaps — scratchpad for HC sync
content:
Purpose: quick prep notes for 1:1 with Aisha + headcount sync on Friday. Focus: immediate loop friction causing offer delays (EM/IC hires), and a lightweight debrief+follow-up plan we can roll out this sprint.

High level thesis (2 lines):
- We are losing velocity in mid-funnel because of scheduling and inconsistent scorecards, not lack of candidates.
- Small process changes (2–3 experiments) should recover 20–30% of time-to-offer in 4 weeks.

Key funnel numbers (current snapshot, rough):
- Req active: 28 (eng: 18, infra: 4, product: 6)
- Candidates in pipeline: 126
- Onsite / final stage: 22 (avg time since first screen: 19 days)
- Offers extended (last 30d): 9 — accepted: 6 / declined: 3
- Dropouts/no-shows at onsites: 14%

Main friction points observed (examples):
- Interview scheduling lag: interview invites take ~4x longer than expected when panelist availability mismatches; recruiting spends heavy time finding slots.
- Debrief latency: hiring managers sometimes wait 48–72h for feedback; causes candidate ghosting.
- Scorecard drift: different interviewers emphasize different signals (design vs shipping bias).
- Technical bar mismatch for infra roles: we’re filtering too aggressively at 2nd screen.

Quick wins to try (prioritized):
1) 2-week panel window (pilot): require panel availability window created by hiring manager at kickoff; recruiting books within window. Owner: Aisha. Target: pilot 5 reqs this sprint.
2) 24h debrief SLA (soft): after last interviewer submits notes, hiring manager commits to 24h to make go/no-go or schedule decision. Add calendar reminder + Slack nudge. Owner: me (Ryan) build nudge template.
3) Unified scorecard template v2: concise 6-question template per role family (eng infra, backend, product); include mandatory pass/fail gate for system design. Owner: Elena + Marcus. Deliverable: doc + one pager.

Longer experiments (if quick wins show impact):
- Panel pre-reads: 1-pager candidate context + focused rubric shared 24h before onsite.
- Recruiter-managed block scheduling: reserve 2hrs blocks weekly for onsite interviews for high-volume teams.

Debrief/playbook draft (scratch):
- At end of loop: interviewer enters 1-sentence summary + 3-line concerns (within 12h).
- Debrief call template (10–15m): 1) outcome (green/yellow/red), 2) top risk, 3) calibration reference (past hire or JD).
- If green -> recruiter to extend verbal offer within 24h; HM to confirm comp band in same window.

Communication templates (notes):
- No-show follow-up: "Hey [Candidate], we missed you at [time]. Are you okay? If you'd like to reschedule, here's a 48‑hour window: [link]."
- Post-onsite candidate update (positive): "Thanks for taking the time — we're consolidating feedback and will share next steps in 24 hours."

Open questions I want to cover in 1:1 with Aisha:
- Are Hiring Managers on board with 24h debrief SLA? What are blockers?
- Can recruiting operationally own a pilot of 5 reqs (time + recruiter headcount)?
- Which 5 reqs to pick for panel-window pilot (mix of infra + product + backend)?
- Any legal/comp constraints for faster verbal offers we should flag?

Immediate action items (scratch list) — assign & quick deadlines:
- Ryan: draft Slack nudge + calendar reminder workflow for debrief SLA (due: Wed 2026-02-25).
- Aisha: confirm panel-window pilot reqs (due: Tue 2026-02-23).
- Elena: start scorecard v2 draft (alpha) and share with Marcus (due: Fri 2026-02-27).
- Marcus: pull last 60-day debrief times and no-show reasons for top 10 reqs (due: Thu 2026-02-26).
- Recruiting ops: mock calendar block flows (2 options) for review (due: Mon 2026-03-01).

Risks & mitigation: 
- Risk: HM resistance to strict SLAs -> Mitigation: make SLA 'recommended' for first 2 weeks; gather metrics and then propose as standard.
- Risk: recruiter bandwidth -> Mitigation: choose only 5 pilot reqs and measure time delta; consider temporary contractor if positive.

Notes to self (loose):
- Bring samples of scorecards that led to accepted offers (for calibration).
- Capture one example of a candidate lost during debrief (timeline + messages) to show impact.
- Try to automate the 24h nudge from Slack bot (ask infra SRE/automation team for quick help).

Meeting agenda (5–7 minutes each item, 30m total):
1) Quick numbers snapshot (me) — 3m
2) Pilot proposal: panel-window + 24h debrief SLA — 8m
3) Scorecard v2 approach + owners — 7m
4) Open questions & req selection — 7m
5) Confirm next steps + owners — 5m

Follow-up format: I will post a one-paragraph update in #talent-org after sync summarizing decisions + next steps; include short ask for HM buy-in.

Archive: once pilot completes, collect metrics: time-to-offer, % no-shows, offer acceptance rate, recruiter hours per req. Keep results as 'pilot-1-hc-recovery-2026' in recruiting workspace.

TODO (personal): stop over-engineering templates in first iteration — ship minimal changes fast.

-- end scratch --
